method: Built-in imagegen; one generated transparent image per bird, converted to 600 × 600 WebP for the app.
promptTemplate:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single isolated bird illustration for a wooden bird-clock configurator.
Style/medium: realistic natural-history plate illustration, very fine colored-pencil and soft gouache detail, crisp delicate feather edges, softly modeled volume, natural accurate proportions, restrained colors with realistic species accents. Match a polished classic field-guide cutout, not a photo, not cartoon, not an icon.
Scene/backdrop: completely transparent alpha background, no paper or colored backdrop.
Composition: square canvas, a SINGLE entire bird centered and filling about 88% of the available canvas; preserve the full beak, crest, tail, both feet and all toes with 5% clear margin. Only bird, no perch, branch, ground, scenery, shadow, frame, lettering, labels, symbols or watermark. Closed wings unless specified; clean separated silhouette suitable for placing over wood grain.

Subject: {subject}
Species: {name} ({scientificName}). Deliver only the single transparent bird asset.
metadataNote: Region is a primary browsing association, not a complete range map. Groups are informal library categories. Reference links verify names and species context; no source artwork was copied.

birds.name: European robin
birds.subject: Adult European robin: orange-red face and breast, olive-brown back, pale belly, slim dark legs, small round body. Compact three-quarter standing pose facing right.

birds.name: Eurasian blue tit
birds.subject: Adult Eurasian blue tit: cobalt-blue crown, wings and tail, white cheeks with dark eye stripe, yellow breast, greenish back. Compact three-quarter standing pose facing left.

birds.name: Common kingfisher
birds.subject: Adult common kingfisher: electric turquoise-blue back and head, copper-orange breast, white throat and neck patch, long straight dark pointed bill, tiny orange feet. Upright three-quarter standing pose facing right.

birds.name: Eurasian hoopoe
birds.subject: Adult Eurasian hoopoe: warm cinnamon head and breast, raised fan-shaped crest tipped black, black-and-white striped wings, slender curved bill. Whole bird standing in three-quarter view facing left, crest and tail completely visible.

birds.name: Lilac-breasted roller
birds.subject: Adult lilac-breasted roller: lilac-pink throat and breast, turquoise belly, blue folded wings, warm tan back and long slender tail tips. Whole bird standing in three-quarter view facing right.

birds.name: African grey parrot
birds.subject: Adult African grey parrot: finely scalloped silver-grey feathers, pale facial skin around a light yellow eye, black hooked bill, vivid short red tail, grasping grey feet. Compact three-quarter upright pose facing left.

birds.name: Grey crowned crane
birds.subject: Adult grey crowned crane: delicate golden bristle crown, black forehead, white cheek patch, small red throat wattle, grey body, white wing panels and long dark legs. Elegant whole-body standing three-quarter pose, wings folded, facing right; include every toe and entire crown.

birds.name: Secretarybird
birds.subject: Adult secretarybird: pale-grey eagle-like head and body, swept black quill crest, orange-red bare skin around the eye, black flight feathers and thigh feathers, very long pale legs, long tail. Whole-body standing three-quarter pose facing left, folded wings; entire legs and feet visible.

birds.name: Mandarin duck
birds.subject: Adult male mandarin duck in ornate breeding plumage: red bill, broad white eye crescent, rust-orange cheek whiskers and upright orange sail feathers, purple chest, cream flanks, dark green crown. Compact whole-body standing profile facing right with two small orange webbed feet, no water.

birds.name: Red-crowned crane
birds.subject: Adult red-crowned crane: long graceful white body, black neck and secondary wing feathers, bare red crown patch, long dark legs and long pointed bill. Whole-body standing three-quarter pose facing left with wings folded, neck gently curved, every foot visible.

birds.name: Indian peafowl
birds.subject: Adult male Indian peafowl: iridescent cobalt-blue neck and breast, delicate upright head crest, green scaled back, folded emerald train with distinct bronze-blue eyespots trailing diagonally behind. Whole-body three-quarter standing pose facing right, train CLOSED not fanned, entire head feet and tail visible.

birds.name: Golden pheasant
birds.subject: Adult male golden pheasant: golden-yellow swept crest, orange-and-black banded neck cape, rich scarlet belly, green upper back and blue wing coverts, long mottled brown tail. Whole-body standing three-quarter pose facing left, tail diagonal so the whole bird fits clearly.

birds.name: Rainbow lorikeet
birds.subject: Adult rainbow lorikeet: deep blue head and belly, bright red-orange bill, orange and yellow breast, emerald-green back and folded wings, long green tail, grey grasping feet. Whole-body three-quarter standing pose facing right.

birds.name: Laughing kookaburra
birds.subject: Adult laughing kookaburra: large cream-white head, broad brown eye stripe, sturdy long dark upper bill and pale lower bill, cream-white breast, brown back and wings with subtle blue patches, rufous-and-black barred tail. Whole-body three-quarter standing pose facing left.

birds.name: Galah
birds.subject: Adult galah cockatoo: warm rose-pink face breast and belly, pale blush-white folded crest, soft silver-grey back wings and tail, pale hooked beak and grey feet. Whole-body three-quarter standing pose facing right.

birds.name: New Zealand fantail
birds.subject: Adult pied New Zealand fantail: grey-brown upperparts, warm buff belly, white eyebrow and throat, dark breast band, broad fully spread black-and-white fan tail. Lively whole-body three-quarter standing pose facing left, tail fan fully visible behind, tiny fine bill and dark feet.
